data: Microsoft reported net income of about $72.7 billion ($72,738 million) for fiscal 2022, which ended June 30, 2022, and about $88.1 billion ($88,136 million) for fiscal 2024, which ended June 30, 2024. That is an increase of roughly $15.4 billion, or about 21.2% over the two years. The growth was not steady, though. Net income fell slightly in fiscal 2023 to about $72.4 billion and then rose about 21.8% in fiscal 2024, helped by growth in its Azure cloud business.
